name: Silk Road Grill
about: Afghan food on Arlington Boulevard in Falls Church. Customers come back for charcoal-grilled kabobs, Qabili Palaw, and generous portions.
address: 6661 Arlington Blvd Service Rd, Falls Church, VA 22042

reviews.author: Ivan S.
reviews.text: Amazing food, really tasty, great quality. Best food I ate in a really long time.

reviews.author: Sameem A.
reviews.text: It was incredibly delicious, tender, and full of rich, smoky flavor from the charcoal grill.

reviews.author: Boykaro K.
reviews.text: I especially loved that they cook everything over real charcoal, unlike many other places that use propane grills.

reviews.author: Amo R.
reviews.text: The Qabili Palaw, tender lamb, flavorful kebabs, and juicy chicken were all outstanding.
